description: This PHP class defines an Immigration display field for the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends a base display field class and specifies related DTO class, entity aliases, and fields involved in the report.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A display field class for immigration records in the reporting system, specifying DTO, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in reports for this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field names related to employee immigration information.
